value.text: Personal Statement Video (max 3 minutes): introduce yourself, share your dance goals and aspirations, and why LMU Dance is the right program.

Dance Proficiency Video (max 2 minutes): a solo in any style that best showcases your unique talents and skills. Compilation videos are NOT accepted. Alternatively, applicants may submit a pre-approval in place of a new solo video.
